@returns The address of this computer that the stream receives on.
@gap Only IPv4, use [GetUDPStreamAddress](GetUDPStreamAddress) for IPv6 too. It is the first address of this computer that [CountHostIPs](CountHostIPs) finds with an empty name, one that other computers can reach if there is any.
@param udp_stream  The stream.
